title: Jobs
description: Run a command on a cron schedule, in a fresh container with this app's env, secrets, volumes and network, or inside its running container.
specManagedHint: Declared in app.yaml. Change it there; only the enabled switch can be toggled here.

empty.title: No jobs yet
empty.description: Run a migration, warm a cache or send a report on a schedule. Each run is kept in the history with its output.

concurrencyHint.allow: Start the new run even if the previous one has not finished.
concurrencyHint.forbid: Skip this run if a previous one is still in flight, recorded as skipped.
concurrencyHint.replace: Cancel the still-running previous run, then start this one.
concurrencyHint.queue: Wait for the previous run to finish, then run, so overlapping runs go one after another.

preview.title: Next runs ({{zone}})
preview.invalid: Enter a valid schedule and time zone to preview the next runs.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameHint: Optional. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.
dialog.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.
dialog.commandHint: Run through a shell (sh -c), so the image needs a shell. Levelrail never interprets it.

modeHint.fresh: A new container from the app's current image, with its env, secrets, volumes and network. It is removed when the run ends.
modeHint.exec: Inside the app's running container. Fails if the container is not running.
modeHint.http: Calls a path on the app over HTTP. A sleeping app is woken first and the call waits for it. Any 2xx answer is a success.

http.pathHint: A path on this app, starting with /. The call goes straight to the app, not through its public domain.
http.backgroundHint: The app can answer 202 at once and keep working. The control plane waits for the answer up to the background timeout and records the outcome, so nobody has to hold the request open.
http.headersHint: Optional. Each row sends a header whose value is read from one of the app's secrets when the job runs, so the secret is never stored in the job.

dialog.timezoneHint: IANA name such as Europe/Berlin. The schedule is read in this zone, including daylight saving changes.
dialog.concurrencyLabel: If a previous run is still going
dialog.timeoutHint: Per attempt. Empty uses the control plane default.
dialog.retriesHint: Extra attempts after a failure, with doubling backoff.

catchUp.skip: Skip missed runs, record them as missed
catchUp.run_once: Run once if a run was missed recently

dialog.memoryHint: Fresh container only. Empty uses the app's own limit.
dialog.warnAfterHint: Raises the running-too-long alert once a run exceeds this. 0 disables it.

delete.title: Delete this job?
delete.description: Its schedule and run history are removed. This cannot be undone.

history.title: Run history
history.description: The most recent runs across this app's jobs, newest first.
history.empty: No runs yet. Use Run now to start one.
history.trendLabel: Run durations for the last {{count}} finished runs
history.trendCaption: Run duration, oldest to newest, slowest {{max}}
history.logsWithheld: Output is hidden because your role cannot read sensitive data.
history.logsRedacted: Secrets are redacted from this output.
history.alertsHint: Get notified when a job fails, misses runs or runs too long with Alerts, using the job failure, missed run or running too long kinds.

historyKept.label: History kept (runs per job)
historyKept.invalid: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

nextRunNeverHint: This schedule has no future run
accessRule: One-off runs and scheduled jobs follow console exec access rules: creating, editing or running a job needs root access on this app and exec enabled for it.
